channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Oso Ighodaro | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Oso Ighodaro from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Khaman Maluach, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
Duane Rankin:Jordan Ott on Suns bigs Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach as Ighodaro will start tonight vs. Pistons:

“Remember they're young players, but all these possessions are valuable to us as we evaluate during the preseason into regular season, we need both of them.”

Jordan Ott on Khaman Maluach, Oso Ighodaro, Oct 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Oso Ighodaro guarding him:

“Pretty impressive. I honestly think he's a pretty good defender. He’s bigger, can move his feet pretty well. I think they just wanted to put size on me.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Oso Ighodaro, Apr 25, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Cody Martin, Oso Ighodaro, Ryan Dunn
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on the Suns switching more with Ryan Dunn, Oso Ighodaro and Cody Martin:

“I feel like that's the most effective way for us to guard is to be able to switch and guard 1-on-1....You've seen something that we maybe can add going forward with those 3”

Kevin Durant on Cody Martin, Oso Ighodaro, Ryan Dunn, Mar 19, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Mason Plumlee, Jusuf Nurkic, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on playing Mason Plumlee and Oso Ighodaro over Jusuf Nurkic:

“They've been good for us, so we'll just continue to try and put together our best combinations”

Mike Budenholzer on Mason Plumlee, Jusuf Nurkic, Oso Ighodaro, Jan 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
“But for me in my position, I’m just trying to find the best opportunity, whether it’s for Bronny, whether it’s for Rob Dillingham, whether it’s for Terrence Shannon, or Justin Edwards, or KJ Simpson, or Oso Ighodaro. Any [Klutch] guys in our class. That’s the draft.”

Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro, Jun 20, 2024. Source: The Ringer.
